mapper.update: INSERT INTO inbody_data (user_id, weight, muscle_mass, body_fat, body_fat_percentage, bmi) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weight}, #{muscleMass}, #{bodyFat}, #{bodyFatPercentage}, #{bmi}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = #{weight}, muscle_mass = #{muscleMass}, body_fat = #{bodyFat}, body_fat_percentage = #{bodyFatPercentage}, bmi = #{bmi}
